name: Shimazaki Yui
source: A plain girl who doesn't stand out in class. She can't negate others' ideas and opinions, and as such, she complies with anything. Not used to talking with males. She also has a peculiar physical trait which she can't tell to anyone. Because of that, she always carries spare panties wherever she goes.
